dialogues.speaker: Flins
dialogues.text: Hold on. Something is struggling within the fissure. And I sense that it... is not the Wild Hunt.

dialogues.speaker: Flins
dialogues.text: Let us break the Hunt's shackles. Perhaps we have come upon an innocent caught in its claws.

dialogues.speaker: Strange Rift
dialogues.text: (Though the monsters have dispersed, the darkness has not faded. You may need to enlist the help of a professional who knows more about the Wild Hunt.)

dialogues.speaker: Flins
dialogues.text: The Wild Hunt has always been a rare sight on Hiisi Island. They seem afraid of the moon's power, and dare not approach.

dialogues.speaker: Flins
dialogues.text: Alright, we've sent the kuuhenki on its way back to Hiisi Island. Hopefully, it stays safe this time.

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: Wait, I think there's something trapped inside that rift...

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: Don't worry. I'll get you out of there.

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: You should be safe now. The moon's power protects this place, so even the Wild Hunt wouldn't dare to come close.

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: There you go, little one. Don't let the Wild Hunt catch you again.
